proof_body:
by
  have hs := Stirling.tendsto_stirlingSeq_sqrt_pi
  have hp : Real.sqrt Real.pi ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2 * n) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := Filter.tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop' (by norm_num)
  have hq := ((hs.comp h2).div (hs.pow 2) (pow_ne_zero 2 hp)).const_mul (Real.sqrt Real.pi)
  have hv : Real.sqrt Real.pi * (Real.sqrt Real.pi / Real.sqrt Real.pi ^ 2) = 1 := by
    field_simp
  rw [hv] at hq
  refine hq.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn
  show Real.sqrt Real.pi * (Stirling.stirlingSeq (2 * n) / Stirling.stirlingSeq n ^ 2) = _
  have hn0 : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have he := Real.exp_pos 1
  have hfact : ((2 * n).factorial : ℝ) = (n.centralBinom : ℝ) * (n.factorial : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    have := Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial (show n ≤ 2 * n by omega)
    rw [show 2 * n - n = n by omega] at this
    rw [Nat.centralBinom, ← this]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hA : (0:ℝ) < n.factorial := by positivity
  have hsn : Real.sqrt (2 * ((2 * n : ℕ) : ℝ)) = 2 * Real.sqrt n := by
    push_cast
    rw [show (2:ℝ) * (2 * (n:ℝ)) = 2 ^ 2 * n by ring, Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)]
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (2 * (n:ℝ)) ^ 2 = 2 * n := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hpow : (((2 * n : ℕ) : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ (2 * n) = 4 ^ n * (((n:ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ n) ^ 2 := by
    push_cast
    rw [show (2 * (n:ℝ)) / Real.exp 1 = 2 * ((n:ℝ) / Real.exp 1) by ring, mul_pow]
    have a1 : (2:ℝ) ^ (2 * n) = 4 ^ n := by rw [pow_mul]; norm_num
    have a2 : ((n:ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ (2 * n) = (((n:ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ n) ^ 2 := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm]
    rw [a1, a2]
  have hpi : Real.sqrt (Real.pi * n) = Real.sqrt Real.pi * Real.sqrt n := Real.sqrt_mul Real.pi_pos.le _
  simp only [Stirling.stirlingSeq]
  rw [hfact, hsn, hpow, hpi]
  have hE : (0:ℝ) < ((n:ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ n := by positivity
  have hsqrt : (0:ℝ) < Real.sqrt n := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hn0
  have hss : Real.sqrt n ^ 2 = (n:ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt hn0.le
  generalize ((n:ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ n = E at *
  rw [div_pow, mul_pow, hsq]
  have h2n : 2 * (n:ℝ) = 2 * Real.sqrt n ^ 2 := by rw [hss]
  rw [h2n]
  generalize Real.sqrt (n:ℝ) = s at *
  generalize (n.factorial : ℝ) = A at *
  generalize (n.centralBinom : ℝ) = C at *
  generalize Real.sqrt Real.pi = p at *
  field_simp
target_source: Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n.centralBinom : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (Real.pi * n) / 4 ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds 1)
